title: Front Desk Check-In

expressions.expr: What seems to be the problem?

I would like to drop off my display. It keeps turning off.

expressions.meaning: Deixa eu conferir o estado do equipamento
expressions.example: Let me check the condition of the equipment before we start.

expressions.expr: I'll call you by Thursday with an estimate
expressions.meaning: Te ligo até quinta com uma estimativa
expressions.example: Here's your receipt. I'll call you by Thursday with an estimate.

sentences: Welcome to GPS Tronic. What seems to be the problem?
My display keeps turning off suddenly.
It has been like this since Tuesday.
The screen does not show the map.
The monitor just will not turn on.
I see a small scratch on the screen, but it is not broken.
Can I have the serial number, please?
I will call you by Thursday with an estimate.

grammar.title: Descrevendo defeitos: keeps + -ing / won't / doesn't
rules: Defeito que se repete toda hora: keeps + verbo com -ing ("It keeps turning off." / "The signal keeps dropping.").
Equipamento que se recusa a ligar/funcionar: won't + verbo base ("It won't turn on.").
Função que não opera no presente: doesn't + verbo base ("The screen doesn't show the map.").
Use since + dia/data para dizer desde quando: "Since Tuesday."
